invariants.description: fCa matches the exact solution: frozen at fCa_init when Vm > -60 mV and fCa_inf > fCa (Paci 2013 constfCa = 0), else fCa_inf(Cai) + (fCa_init - fCa_inf) exp(-t/tau_fCa), tau_fCa = 2 ms; fCa_inf transcribed from the Paci 2013 CellML

bc_sweep.rationale: Vm -100 to +50 mV (both sides of the -60 mV freeze threshold); Cai from diastolic (1e-5 mM) to high systolic (2e-3 mM), covering the fCa_inf transition around 0.6-0.9 uM; fCa_init over [0, 1].

baseline.reason: Ca-dependent inactivation is not measured in isolation; its effect is validated through the whole-cell Ca transient of an assembled Paci model, not this component.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: no free parameters (constants hard-coded in the CellML).
